case_title: Checkout Latency Surge After Helm Chart Parameter Tweak
symptoms: Client pool wait errors in application logs
error_logs: ERROR [checkout-api] Connection acquisition timeout: 30000ms elapsed waiting for pool connection. Pool stats: active=10, pending=89
WARN  [checkout-api] Thread saturation: worker pool 98% capacity utilized
recent_deployment: DEP-9102 updated Helm values for checkout microservice including pool sizing and database timeout settings.
configuration_changes: max_connections modified in deployment values yaml
ground_truth_root_cause: Database connection pool misconfiguration / starvation (pool capped too low for incoming concurrency)
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Scaling pod replicas without fixing DB pool limits

case_title: Rapid Fulfillment Queue Buildup After Autoscaler Migration
symptoms: Queue length jumped to 25,000 unprocessed orders
Individual task execution time is normal (42ms)
error_logs: WARN  [queue-monitor] Backlog threshold exceeded on queue 'order-events' (current: 25400)
recent_deployment: DEP-9120 migrated autoscaler from custom cron to Kubernetes HPA v2.
configuration_changes: HPA minReplicas and concurrency settings adjusted
ground_truth_root_cause: Worker replica count and concurrency settings reduced, causing consumer starvation despite healthy individual message execution

case_title: Immediate 502 Bad Gateway Errors on Internal Payment Endpoint
symptoms: 100% of payment authorization calls fail with HTTP 502
Latency to upstream vault is under 15ms (fast failure)
error_logs: ERROR [envoy-ingress] upstream SSL handshake failed: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
CRIT  [payment-gateway] Downstream payment vault connection terminated with TLS alert 45
recent_deployment: No code deployment in last 48 hours.
ground_truth_root_cause: Expired downstream internal TLS certificate causing ingress SSL handshake failure
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Bypassing ingress SSL checks in production

case_title: Severe Database Load Following Scheduled Cache Expiry
symptoms: Redis cache hit ratio dropped from 99% to 15%
Thousands of identical queries executed concurrently on hot keys
error_logs: WARN  [catalog-cache] High concurrent cache misses detected for single key: 1100 queries in 300ms
ERROR [postgres] slow query duration: 4100ms statement: SELECT * FROM products WHERE is_featured = true
recent_deployment: DEP-9180 updated cache TTL values across catalog domain to uniform 1 hour without jitter.
configuration_changes: Cache key TTL set to exact 3600s
ground_truth_root_cause: Cache stampede / dog-piling due to synchronized key expiration and lack of single-flight mutex lock
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Provisioning a new DB read replica during the incident

case_title: Thread Exhaustion and Pod OOM Crashes from Third-Party API Latency
symptoms: Checkout orchestrator pods experiencing repeated OOMKilled events
Connection pool saturated with sockets held in ESTABLISHED state for >30s
Cascading slowdown across un-related frontend routes
error_logs: WARN  [http-client] Upstream partner payment API taking >28000ms to respond
ERROR [checkout-orchestrator] Socket pool exhausted; 500/500 connections busy
recent_deployment: DEP-9210 upgraded external payment partner SDK with default 60s timeout.
configuration_changes: Partner SDK timeout changed to 60s; circuit breaker disabled
ground_truth_root_cause: Third-party payment gateway degradation causing cascading socket exhaustion and pod crashes due to missing circuit breaker and excessive timeouts
unsuccessful_mitigations_to_avoid: Repeatedly restarting checkout pods without circuit breaking

case_title: Static Assets Returning HTTP 403 on CDN Edge (Novel Incident)
symptoms: Client browsers unable to load static JS/CSS bundles (HTTP 403 Forbidden)
Main web application is healthy and API endpoints return 200
error_logs: ERROR [cloudflare-cdn] Origin returned 403 Forbidden for URI /static/bundle.v2.js
ERROR [s3-origin] AccessDenied: User does not have s3:GetObject on bucket web-assets-prod
recent_deployment: DEP-9250 updated Terraform IAM policy for asset storage bucket.
configuration_changes: S3 bucket policy IAM principal updated
ground_truth_root_cause: S3 bucket IAM policy misconfiguration revoking CDN origin access
